privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: If you submit an inquiry, NTech Labs uses your details to review your project and reply. The configured email provider processes the inquiry for delivery.

first.title: Information you provide
first.body: The inquiry form asks for your name, email, country, customer and project types, project overview, and consent. WhatsApp number, company name, project stage, budget range, and timeline are optional.

second.title: How your inquiry is handled
second.body: When online submission is enabled, NTech Labs uses this information to assess and reply to your inquiry. Resend processes it for email delivery to the configured inbox. The site has no local submissions database. To limit abuse, Upstash Redis holds expiring counters keyed to a one-way, keyed hash of the visitor IP for up to one hour. Inquiry text is sent only to the mail provider.

third.title: Booking and contact services
third.body: If you choose to book a meeting, Google Calendar handles scheduling and any details you provide on its booking page. When you use external contact links, the destination service handles the information you share there.

review.title: Details pending owner approval
review.body: Confirm the legal name of the organization responsible for the information, a privacy contact, retention periods for the inbox and provider, and any applicable rights and request process before enabling live intake.

terms.title: Terms
terms.description: Engagement scope, deliverables, and payment arrangements are agreed separately for each project.

first.title: Project inquiries and meetings
first.body: An inquiry or discovery meeting starts a discussion about your project. A project engagement begins under its own agreed scope and terms.

second.title: Scope and delivery
second.body: The parties agree on deliverables, milestones, responsibilities, review criteria, and handover arrangements for each engagement.

third.title: Payments and project materials
third.body: Payment terms, accepted methods, and rights to project materials are addressed in the engagement agreement. Share only project materials you have permission to use.

review.title: Details pending owner approval
review.body: Confirm the legal contracting entity, applicable jurisdiction, approved contact channel, and any project-specific payment, cancellation, and dispute provisions before publishing these terms.
